_meta.description: Trusted Summit motion primitives. Generated websites should request these by data attributes instead of inventing custom animation systems.

reveal_up.label: Reveal Up
reveal_up.description: Fade and translate content into place when it enters the viewport.

accessibility.fallback_behavior: Render immediately with no transform when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.
accessibility.focus_notes: Never delay focusable controls long enough to make keyboard navigation confusing.

implementation_notes: Default duration should be 420ms with ease-out.

gradient_mesh.label: Gradient Mesh Background
gradient_mesh.description: A soft animated background made from layered radial gradients.

attributes.data-bg-palette: optional brand, warm, cool, or neutral

accessibility.fallback_behavior: Keep the static gradient, disable animated background position and transforms.
accessibility.contrast_notes: Overlay text areas must still pass WCAG AA contrast.

implementation_notes: Prefer CSS pseudo-elements over DOM-heavy layers.
Do not use random bright colors outside the selected palette.

parallax_image.label: Parallax Image
parallax_image.description: Move an image slightly slower than page scroll for depth.
avoid_contexts: images above text that must remain aligned

accessibility.fallback_behavior: Use the same image with no transform.
accessibility.content_notes: Do not hide essential information inside moving imagery.

implementation_notes: Use requestAnimationFrame and passive scroll listeners if needed.

sticky_cta.label: Sticky CTA
sticky_cta.description: A small persistent action bar that appears after the hero.

attributes.data-sticky-after: optional CSS selector or viewport percentage

avoid_contexts: pages with no real phone, email, or booking destination

accessibility.fallback_behavior: CTA remains visible without entrance animation.
accessibility.focus_notes: Must be reachable by keyboard and must not cover form controls.

implementation_notes: Use actual tel, mailto, or scraped booking URL only.

cursor_spotlight.label: Cursor Spotlight
cursor_spotlight.description: A subtle radial light follows the pointer within a hero or feature area.

accessibility.fallback_behavior: Render a static radial gradient or no spotlight.
accessibility.contrast_notes: The spotlight must not reduce text contrast.

implementation_notes: Use CSS variables updated on pointermove.

water_attractor.label: Water Attractor Hero
water_attractor.description: A canvas water field whose droplets and ripple rings are pulled toward pointer movement, like dragging a finger across water.
allowed_contexts: service pages where water, fluid, inspection, precision, or flow is relevant

accessibility.fallback_behavior: Render a static low-density canvas texture when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.
accessibility.contrast_notes: Hero text must sit above the canvas with a scrim or solid overlay so it remains readable.

implementation_notes: Add the attribute to the hero section only; do not add inline water JavaScript.
Use data-water-palette="aqua" for water-first brands, "fire" for fire/backflow and industrial service sites, and "ink" for dark premium heroes.
Keep a readable overlay between the canvas and hero copy.
